kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-dhcp-options-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dhcp-options-set-id dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDhcpOptionsSet

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DHCP options set that you want to delete. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的DHCP选项集所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DHCP options set that you want to delete
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the DHCP options set is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除DHCP选项集。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除DHCP选项集
parameters.name: dry_run
